tools.name: koban_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Koban account (login, name, active state). Use it to find the user id for assignments. Koban API: GET /ncAuthenticate/GetUsers.

tools.name: koban_search_accounts
tools.description: Search Koban accounts (companies and persons) by label. Returns matching accounts with status, type and assignment. Koban API: GET /ncThird/GetByLabel.

tools.name: koban_get_account
tools.description: Get one Koban account by its id, including address, status, type, tags and custom fields. Koban API: GET /ncThird/GetOne.

tools.name: koban_get_account_by_external_code
tools.description: Get one Koban account by your own external code (Extcode). Use it when your system stores the Koban link by external code. Koban API: GET /ncThird/GetOneByExtcode.

tools.name: koban_list_updated_accounts
tools.description: List accounts changed after a Unix time, one page at a time. Use it for incremental sync. Koban API: GET /ncThird/GetUpdated.

tools.name: koban_find_contact_by_email
tools.description: Find Koban contacts by their e-mail address. Returns the matching contacts and their accounts. Koban API: GET /ncContact/GetByEMail.

tools.name: koban_get_contact
tools.description: Get one Koban contact by its id, including name, e-mail, phone, function and tags. Koban API: GET /ncContact/GetOne.

tools.name: koban_list_updated_contacts
tools.description: List contacts changed after a Unix time, one page at a time. Use it for incremental sync. Koban API: GET /ncContact/GetUpdated.

tools.name: koban_get_lead
tools.description: Get one Koban lead by its id, including the person, company, status and tags. Koban API: GET /ncLead/GetOne.

tools.name: koban_list_leads_by_status
tools.description: List Koban leads that have one status code (for example MQL), one page at a time. Koban API: GET /ncLead/GetByStatus.

tools.name: koban_get_deal
tools.description: Get one Koban deal by its id, including its process, amount, owner and status. Koban API: GET /ncDeal/GetOne.

tools.name: koban_list_deals_for_account
tools.description: List all Koban deals linked to one account id. Koban API: GET /ncDeal/GetForThird.

tools.name: koban_list_updated_deals
tools.description: List deals changed after a Unix time, one page at a time. Use it for incremental sync. Koban API: GET /ncDeal/GetUpdated.

tools.name: koban_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one Koban invoice by its id, including number, amounts, status and lines. Koban API: GET /ncInvoice/GetOne.

tools.name: koban_list_updated_invoices
tools.description: List invoices changed after a Unix time, one page at a time. Use it for incremental sync. Koban API: GET /ncInvoice/GetUpdated.

tools.name: koban_list_updated_orders
tools.description: List orders changed after a Unix time, one page at a time. Koban API: GET /ncOrder/GetUpdated.

tools.name: koban_get_action
tools.description: Get one Koban action (task, call or meeting) by its id. Koban API: GET /ncAction/Get.

tools.name: koban_list_pending_actions
tools.description: List the open actions of one user, optionally in a date range. Koban API: GET /ncAction/GetPending.

tools.name: koban_upsert_account
tools.description: Create an account, or update the account that has this external code. Existing fields not sent are kept. Koban API: POST /ncThird/PostOne with uniqueproperty=Extcode.

tools.name: koban_upsert_contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or update the contact that has this external code. Optionally link it to an account by the account's external code. Koban API: POST /ncContact/PostOne.

tools.name: koban_create_action
tools.description: Create a new action (task, call or meeting) for a user, linked to an account or a deal. Each call creates a new action; a retry creates a duplicate. Koban API: POST /ncAction/Post.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: koban_find_contact_by_email · Private data: koban_find_contact_by_email, koban_get_contact, koban_list_updated_contacts, koban_upsert_contact · Public sink: koban_find_contact_by_email, koban_upsert_account, koban_upsert_contact, koban_create_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: koban_find_contact_by_email · Private data: koban_find_contact_by_email, koban_get_contact, koban_list_updated_contacts, koban_upsert_contact · Public sink: koban_find_contact_by_email, koban_upsert_account, koban_upsert_contact, koban_create_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
